text:
matt: Heads up — planning a small k8s change for the statefulset that serves persistent sessions. Proposal: change updateStrategy to RollingUpdate with a partitioned canary, temporarily scale replicas 3 -> 2 to simulate node loss, add tolerations for taint node=spot:NoSchedule, and move secret mount from /etc/creds -> /etc/secrets. PR: https://git.internal/repo/pulls/2345. Any red flags around PVC/PV detach or ordinals?

sanjay: Dropping 3->2 on a StatefulSet will delete the highest ordinal (pod-2). That pod's PVC stays (we use Retain), but app must handle session loss for that specific ordinal. Are we ok deleting pod-2 during the canary?

tasha: +1 to partitioned rollout instead of blunt scale down. Use RollingUpdate with rollingUpdate.partition to control which ordinals update. Also check readinessProbe timings — short probes can cause flapping during drain.

deploy-bot: PR 2345 created by matt — terraform plan triggered: https://ci.internal/plan/9876 (shows helm_release/myapp update) :white_check_mark:

isabel: Quick correction — maxSurge/maxUnavailable are Deployment fields. StatefulSet RollingUpdate supports `partition`, not surge. So don't set maxSurge on the STS, it'll be ignored. Use: 
```yaml
updateStrategy:
  type: RollingUpdate
  rollingUpdate:
    partition: 3  # set to current to freeze, lower to advance
```

matt: Right, that was my mistake. I'll remove maxSurge from the manifest. Plan is: 1) set rollingUpdate.partition=2 for a 1-pod canary (updates pods with ordinal >=2?), 2) watch session handoff, 3) lower partition to 0 to finish. Also updating volumeMount path in Helm values and app env var to point at /etc/secrets.

devops: FYI Terraform stores the helm values in `helm_values.yaml` via the helm_release. I'll update the tfvars to change `extraVolumeMounts` and `replicaCount`. Will run `terraform plan` and paste output. Don't forget to bump chart version or helm_release will report drift.

sanjay: Readiness probe note: current probe is `initialDelaySeconds: 5, timeoutSeconds: 1` — for graceful drain bump to `initialDelaySeconds: 10, timeoutSeconds: 2` and consider `periodSeconds: 5`. Also add a preStop hook so app has a short window to close connections: 
```yaml
lifecycle:
  preStop:
    exec:
      command: ["/bin/sh", "-c", "sleep 10"]
```

matt: Good call on preStop and probes, will add both. For the canary I'll set `rollingUpdate.partition: 2` initially so only pod-2 is left on old revision (confirming behavior). After verification set partition -> 0 to complete rollout. I'll push an updated PR with runbook.

devops: Terraform plan summary: `helm_release.myapp` will change values: `replicaCount: 2`, `rollingUpdate.partition: 2`, `extraVolumeMounts.mountPath: /etc/secrets`. No PV replacements. Scheduling canary for the 2–3pm window today. @team-ops hold HPA autoscaling during the window.

isabel: One more: check PV reclaimPolicy. If it were `Delete` and we removed a PVC somehow we'd risk data loss. Our PVs are `Retain`, so scaling down is safe.

matt: Thanks all. I'll push the PR and include a short rollout runbook in the PR description: 1) apply terraform, 2) watch ordinal pods come up, 3) verify session continuity and logs, 4) revert partition if any failure. Tagging @oncall for the window. PR: https://git.internal/repo/pulls/2345

oncall: Oncall available for the 2–3pm window, will monitor metrics and be ready to rollback. :thumbsup:
